answer: Each agent stakes a bonded deposit and must solve a rotating beacon challenge tied to its on-chain history; every epoch the protocol samples one pearl of verified work from a shared meadow of prior attestations and requires fresh proof of possession. Sybils must fund and independently sustain many identities, paying the stake plus repeated solve costs, so forgery scales linearly in real capital while honest agents reuse one bonded identity.
